  "check_code": "import hashlib
import re
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path


TARGET_PLAN = "CAPA-L1-OD-2025-09"
TARGET_CODE = "T2-VERIFY-POST-REPAIR-VIBRATION"


def _db_path(workspace, system_name):
    return Path(workspace).parent / "system" / system_name / "state.db"


def _rows(workspace, system_name, sql, params=()):
    with sqlite3.connect(_db_path(workspace, system_name)) as connection:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(sql, params).fetchall()]


def _normalized(value):
    text = str(value or "").lower().replace("_", " ")
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text).split())


def controlled_action_created(workspace):
    rows = _rows(
        workspace,
        "jira_capa",
        """SELECT capa_plan_id, owner_person_id, priority_tier, action_code,
                  workflow_status, action_title, action_detail, due_date_key
           FROM action_items WHERE action_code = ?""",
        (TARGET_CODE,),
    )
    if len(rows) != 1:
        return {"score": 0, "detail": f"Expected one controlled action; found {len(rows)}."}
    action = rows[0]
    structured = (
        action["capa_plan_id"] == TARGET_PLAN
        and action["owner_person_id"] == "PERSON-MARCEL-IONESCU"
        and action["priority_tier"] == 2
        and action["workflow_status"] == "OPEN"
        and action["due_date_key"] == 20251020
    )
    text = _normalized(f"{action['action_title']} {action['action_detail']}")
    has_work_order = "wo 2025 0912" in text
    has_vibration = "vibration" in text
    has_temporal_requirement = any(
        phrase in text
        for phrase in (
            "post completion",
            "after completion",
            "after work order completion",
            "post repair",
            "after repair",
        )
    )
    has_traceability = (
        any(word in text for word in ("linked", "traceable", "traceably", "attached", "associated"))
        and any(word in text for word in ("reading", "measurement", "evidence", "record"))
    )
    passed = structured and has_work_order and has_vibration and has_temporal_requirement and has_traceability
    return {
        "score": 1 if passed else 0,
        "detail": (
            "The unique action has the required plan, owner, tier, status, gate date, and traceable post-completion vibration evidence requirement."
            if passed
            else "The controlled action is missing, has an incorrect structured field, or lacks the required work-order-specific evidence language."
        ),
    }


def existing_plan_actions_unchanged(workspace):
    expected = {
        "ACT-L1-OD-001": ("PERSON-ELENA-PETRESCU", 1, "T1-CONTAIN-10900-GONO", "DONE", "100% containment sorting at calibrated 10.900 mm", "Sort all suspect crankcases using a calibrated 10.900 mm go/no-go verification before release.", 20250912),
        "ACT-L1-OD-002": ("PERSON-MARCEL-IONESCU", 2, "T2-REPAIR-BACKLASH", "IN_PROGRESS", "Repair machine backlash source", "Inspect and repair axis backlash identified during the dimensional-defect root-cause review.", 20250926),
        "ACT-L1-OD-003": ("PERSON-MARCEL-IONESCU", 2, "T2-REMOVE-VIBRATION", "IN_PROGRESS", "Remove vibration sources", "Correct spindle and workholding vibration sources and document the verification run.", 20250930),
        "ACT-L1-OD-004": ("PERSON-SOFIA-MATEI", 2, "T2-REPLACE-CUTTING-ELEMENT", "OPEN", "Replace worn cutting elements", "Replace the worn cutting insert and record tool-life limits for the affected operation.", 20251003),
        "ACT-L1-OD-005": ("PERSON-SOFIA-MATEI", 2, "T2-REQUALIFY-FIXTURE-CLAMP", "IN_PROGRESS", "Requalify fixture clamping", "Requalify fixture clamping force and repeatability after the containment repair.", 20251006),
        "ACT-L1-OD-006": ("PERSON-ELENA-PETRESCU", 3, "T3-ISSUE-STANDARDIZED-WORK", "OPEN", "Issue standardized operator work", "Publish the revised setup, measurement, reaction-plan, and escalation instructions.", 20251010),
        "ACT-L1-OD-007": ("PERSON-ANDREI-POPESCU", 3, "T3-LAYERED-PROCESS-AUDIT", "OPEN", "Start layered-process audits", "Run layered audits against the revised standardized work and retain findings for the effectiveness gate.", 20251013),
    }
    rows = _rows(
        workspace,
        "jira_capa",
        """SELECT action_item_id, owner_person_id, priority_tier, action_code,
                  workflow_status, action_title, action_detail, due_date_key
           FROM action_items WHERE capa_plan_id = ?""",
        (TARGET_PLAN,),
    )
    by_id = {row["action_item_id"]: row for row in rows}
    unchanged = True
    for action_id, values in expected.items():
        row = by_id.get(action_id)
        actual = None if row is None else (
            row["owner_person_id"], row["priority_tier"], row["action_code"],
            row["workflow_status"], row["action_title"], row["action_detail"], row["due_date_key"],
        )
        unchanged = unchanged and actual == values
    target_count = sum(1 for row in rows if row["action_code"] == TARGET_CODE)
    passed = unchanged and len(rows) == 8 and target_count == 1
    return {
        "score": 1 if passed else 0,
        "detail": (
            "All seven pre-existing plan actions are unchanged and exactly one new action was added."
            if passed
            else "A pre-existing action changed, the plan action count is not eight, or the target action is not unique."
        ),
    }


def source_records_unchanged(workspace):
    plan_rows = _rows(
        workspace,
        "jira_capa",
        """SELECT quality_case_id, product_id, line_id, approval_date_key,
                  next_review_date_key, source_event_date_key, plan_status,
                  approval_state, overall_progress_pct_scaled, plan_title
           FROM capa_plans WHERE capa_plan_id = ?""",
        (TARGET_PLAN,),
    )
    expected_plan = {
        "quality_case_id": "QC-L1-OD-2025-09",
        "product_id": "PROD-RADIAL-TURBOCHARGER-CRANKCASE",
        "line_id": "LINE-PC-01",
        "approval_date_key": 20250918,
        "next_review_date_key": 20251020,
        "source_event_date_key": 20250905,
        "plan_status": "APPROVED",
        "approval_state": "LEADERSHIP_APPROVED",
        "overall_progress_pct_scaled": 5000000,
        "plan_title": "Line 1 three-tier CAPA for recurring OD dimensional defects",
    }
    work_order_rows = _rows(
        workspace,
        "ibm_maximo",
        """SELECT asset_id, quality_case_id, work_type, status, description,
                  opened_at, completion_at, target_completion_date, priority
           FROM work_orders WHERE work_order_id = ?""",
        ("WO-2025-0912",),
    )
    expected_work_order = {
        "asset_id": "ASSET-L1-MC-014",
        "quality_case_id": "QC-L1-OD-2025-09",
        "work_type": "CORRECTIVE",
        "status": "COMPLETED",
        "description": "Investigate undersize drift and check spindle backlash",
        "opened_at": "2025-09-03T07:40:00",
        "completion_at": "2025-09-04T16:20:00",
        "target_completion_date": "2025-09-05",
        "priority": 2,
    }
    reading_rows = _rows(
        workspace,
        "ibm_maximo",
        """SELECT asset_id, work_order_id, reading_type, reading_value_scaled,
                  scale_factor, unit_code, reading_timestamp, measurement_phase
           FROM condition_readings WHERE work_order_id = ? ORDER BY reading_id""",
        ("WO-2025-0912",),
    )
    expected_reading = {
        "asset_id": "ASSET-L1-MC-014",
        "work_order_id": "WO-2025-0912",
        "reading_type": "VIBRATION",
        "reading_value_scaled": 480,
        "scale_factor": 100,
        "unit_code": "MM_S",
        "reading_timestamp": "2025-09-03T09:10:00",
        "measurement_phase": "PRE_REPAIR",
    }
    control_plan = Path(workspace) / "03_CAPA" / "Line1_CorrectiveAction_ControlPlan.xlsx"
    file_ok = control_plan.exists() and hashlib.sha256(control_plan.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "a86ae606304191eaaac6ce7d9243af1b92f3c8fcd9e0b7d965f51ef84cdbd2ac"
    passed = (
        plan_rows == [expected_plan]
        and work_order_rows == [expected_work_order]
        and reading_rows == [expected_reading]
        and file_ok
    )
    return {
        "score": 1 if passed else 0,
        "detail": (
            "The approved plan, referenced Maximo evidence, and control-plan workbook are unchanged."
            if passed
            else "A protected source plan, Maximo record, or control-plan workbook changed."
        ),
    }
